name: Employer
overview: The Scriptures emphasize that employers must treat their workers with fairness and respect, ensuring timely payment of wages and avoiding any form of defrauding or oppression, as seen in Leviticus 19:13 and Deuteronomy 24:14-15. Employers are also called to show compassion and reverence for God by not ruling over their servants harshly (Leviticus 25:43) and by allowing rest on the Sabbath for all, including servants (Deuteronomy 5:14). The integrity of an employer is further highlighted in Job 31:13, where despising the cause of servants is presented as a serious moral failure.
